figurative_meaning_bn: সহচর শব্দ; সাপ ও অনুরূপ সরীসৃপাদি
figurative_meaning_en: Rhyming compound word; snakes and similar reptiles
example_sentences_in_english: This jungle is a hangout for snakes and reptiles.
Be cautious if you spot snakes and reptiles.
note: সাপখোপ is a traditional rhyming pair in Bengali used to evoke images of hazardous, untamed natural environments.
